title: Hotels with a Burj Khalifa view: which room to book
metaDescription: Five Dubai hotels with Burj Khalifa view rooms, the exact room category to book, and the fountain, sea, lake and city view rooms that look elsewhere.
h1: Hotels with a Burj Khalifa view, and which room to book
dek: Five Dubai hotels in Downtown and along Sheikh Zayed Road. For each one we list the exact room category sold with the view, and the fountain, sea, lake and city view rooms that look elsewhere.
teaser: From a hotel with the tower in seven room names to one that sells it as a fountain view.

alternatives.title: No view room? Try a pool or terrace
alternatives.text: Forbes Travel Guide describes Burj Khalifa views from the Address Downtown's rooms and suites in general, and also from its outdoor pool, The Garden bar and the Lobby Lounge terrace. It names no room category for the view.

extras.title: Burj Khalifa tickets
extras.note: Not the same view: from the observation deck you look out over Dubai, not at the tower. Tiqets lists At the Top tickets for levels 124/125 and 148, and says entry is strictly timed and late arrivals may not be admitted.

faq.q: Which Dubai hotels sell rooms with a Burj Khalifa view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Address Sky View, Sofitel Dubai Downtown, Ramada by Wyndham Downtown Dubai and Shangri-La Dubai sell categories with the Burj Khalifa in the name. Palace Downtown sells fountain view categories, and a guide says to book those for the tower.

faq.q: Does the Armani Hotel Dubai have a Burj Khalifa view?
faq.a: Not in the usual sense. The hotel is inside the Burj Khalifa, so Chris and Wren's guide says it doesn't technically have a view of it.

faq.q: Is a fountain view the same as a Burj Khalifa view?
faq.a: Not by room name. The Ramada by Wyndham Downtown Dubai sells “Fountain View” and “Burj Khalifa/Fountain View” as separate categories, and a guide says the tower is partly blocked from the first.

faq.q: Is the Burj Khalifa view at the Sofitel Dubai Downtown a full view?
faq.a: For one category, the hotel says no. Its page for the Luxury Club Burj Khalifa View King calls the view partial, from the higher floors.
